newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said Commission President Jacques Santer and Commissioner Hans van den Broek would meet Polish Prime Minister Wlodzimierz Cimoszewicz at 1500/1400 GMT. He also said they would meet the press at 1600/1500 GMT in the VIP corner.

Van der Pas said the Commission's meeting with U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright on Tuesday from 0915/0815 GMT to 1015/0915 GMT would go over the new transatlantic agenda, EU enlargement, Economic and Monetary Union and relations with Africa in the framework of the situation in the Great Lakes region. He also said the news conference foreseen at 1020/0920 GMT would not be confirmed before Monday afternoon.

Spokesman Peter Guilford briefed on the telecoms agreement reached Saturday in Geneva (see separate story BC-TRADE-TELECOMS). He said the agreement, the biggest since the one reached in 1993 under the Uruguay Round of world trade negotiations, was of immense importance for the Commission. He also said that put with the Information Technology Agreement (ITA), it formed a good cocktail for economic growth.

Spokesman Josep Coll i Carbo briefed on the EU - Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and EU - Asia-Europe Foreign Ministers Meeting (ASEM) meetings in Singapore last week. Coll i Carbo notably said decisions on new ASEM members would be made at the next Asia-Europe summit due next April in London.
Van der Pas said President Santer would address the European Parliament on BSE on Tuesday between 1530/1430 GMT and 1600/1500 GMT in Strasbourg. He said it would be retransmitted in Brussels.
Spokesman Willy Helin and spokeswoman Elisabetta Olivi briefed on Spanish Economy and Finance Minister Rodrigo De Rato's meetings with Commissioners Karel Van Miert and Mario Monti in the morning.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/123: The Commission approves the acquisition by KNP group of two paper companies in Germany and Italy.
- Speech/97/38: Speech By Commissioner Christos Papoutsis at the seminar on the Energy Charter Treaty.
